selected.citation: Office for National Statistics, Risk factors for prediabetes and undiagnosed type 2 diabetes in England: 2013 to 2019, published 19 February 2024
selected.design: National Health Survey for England 2013–2019; multistage stratified probability household sampling and survey weights. Adults 16+ in private households. Overall analytic n=26,751.

prediabetes.denominator: All adults who rated their health good or very good

undiagnosed_type_2_diabetes.denominator: Adults with type 2 diabetes who rated their health good or very good

limits: Historical England estimates, not current Spanish prevalence.
The 46% denominator requires both type 2 diabetes and good/very-good self-rated health. The two percentage denominators differ.
These findings concern self-rated health, not a previously normal full blood panel or a rate of missed disease in routine checkups.
The source study uses HbA1c; this does not add HbA1c to the 13-marker kit or claim that EVA diagnoses diabetes.
